verdict.rationale: Versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for a collaboration platform that supports workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST/Graph CRUD, batching, webhooks and a Recycle operation for deleted objects, but none of it covers versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. Community mentions of building flows describe usage, not version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
